2|    """Copy the horizontal seed pattern onto each isolated marker cell."""
3|    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
4|    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
5|    from collections import Counter
6|
7|    background = Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
8|    # Locate the longest horizontal contiguous non-background run: this is
9|    # the seed object, while the remaining non-background cells are markers.
10|    best = None
11|    for r, row in enumerate(g):
12|        c = 0
13|        while c < w:
14|            if row[c] == background:
15|                c += 1
16|                continue
17|            start = c
18|            while c < w and row[c] != background:
19|                c += 1
20|            if best is None or c - start > best[2] - best[1]:
21|                best = (r, start, c)
22|    if best is None:
23|        return g
24|    sr, sc, se = best
25|    pattern = g[sr][sc:se]
26|    seed_cells = {(sr, c) for c in range(sc, se)}
27|    markers = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
28|               if g[r][c] != background and (r, c) not in seed_cells]
29|    anchor = len(pattern) // 2
30|    for r, c in markers:
